answer: Raise the cost of cloned keys with geometric deposits and duplicate-cluster slashing. The first identity can post after a modest lock, but each extra key must lock a larger sum, recovered only after several quiet epochs. Reviewers hash distinctive clauses and treat a tight cluster of near-copies as one actor. A genuine history builds like layered shale, slow and ordered, while a sockpuppet farm is just a dune of names. Once a shared reasoning thread is found, every linked deposit is burned, so farming many faces costs more than doing the work once.
